controls: ASRProvider is the canonical capability contract and the production ASRBackend boundary aliases it; SequentialBackendPool validates and invokes this contract.
The duplicate drafting protocol was removed; deterministic and bounded JSON drafting implementations share the provider-neutral DraftingProvider contract.
Structural conformance tests cover FasterWhisperAdapter, OmiBackend and ParakeetOnnxBackend, plus DeterministicProvider and JSONProvider.
A dependency test ensures declared runtime and optional Python dependencies do not require paid-provider SDKs.
No paid calls, network model downloads, or provider-specific package additions were made.

ci_history.finding: The ASR-enabled lane found the source-derived service catalog was stale after moving ASRProvider into the runtime interface dependency graph. Regenerated docs/service-catalog.md and verified it with the catalog tests.

limitations: Runtime structural conformance proves the named local adapters expose the contract methods; it does not establish ASR or clinical performance.
The hosted JSON adapter remains opt-in and bounded; this task made no paid requests.
Local mypy was run with --ignore-missing-imports because optional audio and ASR packages are not installed in this workstation environment; exact-commit CI type checks passed.
